tests.summary: The control-plane CLI compiled successfully in the generated validation tree.
Examples passed and negative tests rejected an unsafe main-branch task and an incomplete completed report.
Task, run-report, and certification examples validated.

deviations: The implementation was bootstrapped directly from the approved ChatGPT design rather than an issue that predated the new control plane.
known_limitations: GitHub Actions was pending when this report was created.
Windsurf and VS Code MCP authentication must be completed manually on the authorized workstations; no credentials are stored in Git.
No GPU, ONNX, checkpoint, Render deployment, calibration-audio, or listening certification was required or claimed for this control-plane-only change.
A cross-repository GitHub Project board and automatic agent dispatch are intentionally deferred.
notes: The commit field identifies the final implementation commit before this evidence-only task/report commit.
